description: Which of the world's stock exchanges are open right now (or at a given time)? Returns every tracked exchange with its open flag and status — ideal for "which markets are trading?".

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to evaluate AT a specific moment (e.g. "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z"). Defaults to now. Use it for "will the NYSE be open at 3pm ET on Monday?".

name: markets_open_now
